← Reading Habit Coach

Make room for a few good pages.

Track reading time and pages without turning your favourite pastime into another obligation.

How can I track my reading habits?

Add your current book, start a session, then pause or finish when you need to. Update the page you reached or log a session afterwards.

Time that reflects your reading

Paused time is excluded. Active time is split across calendar days using the session’s saved timezone. Audiobook listening stays measured in time, with no invented page conversion.
